def extract_invoice_fields(document_text: str, metadata: Dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = get_openai_client()
    request = DocumentExtractionRequest(document_type="invoice", text=document_text, metadata=metadata or {})
    prompt = (
        "Extract structured invoice fields as JSON with keys: vendor, date, total, line_items. "
        "Each line item should include description, quantity, unit_price, amount. "
        "Return only valid JSON.\n\n"
        f"Document:\n{request.text}"
    )
    response = client.responses.create(
        model=MODEL_ID,
        input=prompt,
        temperature=0,

    data.setdefault("document_type", "invoice")

","document_client.py":"import os
from functools import lru_cache
from openai import OpenAI

OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
OPENAI_MODEL_ENV = "STRUCTURED_DOC_MODEL"
OPENAI_NORMALIZATION_MODEL_ENV = "STRUCTURED_DOC_NORMALIZATION_MODEL"
OPENAI_VALIDATION_MODEL_ENV = "STRUCTURED_DOC_VALIDATION_MODEL"


def _env(name: str, default: str) -> str:
    return os.getenv(name, default)


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_openai_client() -> OpenAI:
    return OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv(OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV))


def get_extraction_model(document_type: str) -> str:
    if document_type == "invoice":
        return _env(OPENAI_MODEL_ENV, "gpt-4.1-mini")
    if document_type == "receipt":
        return _env(OPENAI_MODEL_ENV, "gpt-4.1-mini")
    return _env(OPENAI_MODEL_ENV, "gpt-4.1-mini")


def get_normalization_model() -> str:
    return _env(OPENAI_NORMALIZATION_MODEL_ENV, "gpt-4.1-mini")


def get_validation_model() -> str:
    return _env(OPENAI_VALIDATION_MODEL_ENV, "gpt-4.1-mini")
","document_models.py":"import json
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, List


@dataclass
class DocumentExtractionRequest:
    document_type: str
    text: str
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass
class ValidationResult:
    valid: bool
    missing_fields: List[str]
    low_confidence_fields: List[str]
    score: float
    raw: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


def parse_json_response(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if not text:
        return {}
    start = text.find("{")
    end = text.rfind("}")
    if start != -1 and end != -1 and end > start:
        text = text[start : end + 1]
    return json.loads(text)


def normalize_expense_record(model_output: str, fallback: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        parsed = parse_json_response(model_output)
    except Exception:
        parsed = {}
    normalized = dict(fallback)
    normalized.update(parsed)
    normalized.setdefault("source_type", fallback.get("document_type", "expense"))
    return normalized


def parse_validation_result(text: str) -> ValidationResult:
    data = parse_json_response(text)
    return ValidationResult(
        valid=bool(data.get("valid", False)),
        missing_fields=list(data.get("missing_fields", [])),
        low_confidence_fields=list(data.get("low_confidence_fields", [])),
        score=float(data.get("score", 0.0)),
        raw=data,
    )

","expense_record_store.py":"from typing import Any, Dict
from google.cloud import firestore

FIRESTORE_COLLECTION_ENV = "EXPENSE_RECORDS_COLLECTION"


def persist_expense_record(record: Dict[str, Any], project_id: str | None = None) -> str:
    db = firestore.Client(project=project_id)
    collection_name = record.get("collection") or "expense_records"
    doc_ref = db.collection(collection_name).document()
    doc_ref.set(record)
    return doc_ref.id
